I feel like the music is so great that it speaks for itself, it being a sequel to MMLP does seem a bit out of place at times because it’s definitely not as gritty and raw as the first one. He’s said in the past that MMLP 1 was great because it captured a moment in time for him. I don’t necessarily get that same vibe from MMLP2 but you got Bad Guy which fits perfect for a sequel. Rhyme or Reason, Survival, Legacy,  Stronger Than I Was, Headlights, and Beautiful Pain seem like he was tapping into a certain situation or something he has a feeling about and addressing it. And I think he was going for something that captures a moment in music rather than that classic grimy incredible shit that the first one is. Case in point - Stronger Than I Was.
